title: Switch bank
description: Relays, inputs and how they appear on SignalK and NMEA 2000.

keys.name: bank_id
keys.title: Relay bank id
keys.description: Switch-bank number of the 8 relays, on SignalK and NMEA 2000. Give every board on the boat its own.

keys.name: input_bank_id
keys.title: Input bank id
keys.description: Switch-bank number of the 8 inputs. Must differ from the relay bank id, or the inputs are not published.

keys.name: debounce_ms
keys.title: Input debounce
keys.description: How long an input must be steady before a change counts. Inputs are read every 10 ms.

keys.name: sk_grace_s
keys.title: SignalK-loss grace period
keys.description: How long SignalK may be unreachable before relays set to switch off do so.

keys.name: sk_repub_s
keys.title: SignalK republish interval
keys.description: Resend every relay and input state to SignalK this often, even when nothing changed, so apps don't show them as stale. 0 = send changes only.

keys.name: eth_enabled
keys.title: Ethernet enabled
keys.description: Off = WiFi only. For Ethernet only, turn off WiFi's Station enabled instead.

keys.name: pub_switches
keys.title: Publish electrical.switches.bank.*
keys.description: The standard SignalK switch-bank paths. Relays can be switched through them.

keys.name: pub_controls
keys.title: Publish electrical.controls.*
keys.description: Paths in the style of SignalK RFC 0009. Relays can be switched through them.

keys.name: led_brightness
keys.title: Status LED brightness
keys.description: Green = fine, blue = no SignalK connection, amber = warning, red = alarm. 0 turns the LED off.

keys.name: buzzer_alarm
keys.title: Buzzer on alarm
keys.description: Beep while a health alarm is active: "ESP" and the last number of the device's IP address, in Morse.

keys.name: buzzer_freq_hz
keys.title: Buzzer frequency
keys.description: Tone of the alarm buzzer. Passive buzzers are loudest near their resonance; use the relay page's Test buzzer button to try a value.

keys.name: buzzer_event
keys.title: Buzzer on events
keys.description: Chirp on boot, on a BOOT-button action, on a relay switching on/off (direct commands only, not automatic changes), and on an input's level changing. Separate from "Buzzer on alarm" -- a boat is a quiet-hours environment. Silenced entirely while the alarm is sounding or the BOOT button's override is active.

keys.name: tone_patterns
keys.title: Tone patterns
keys.description: Named RTTTL (Ring Tone Text Transfer Language) tone library, edited on the Tones page (/tones). Every event/channel setting below picks its chirp from this list by name.

keys.name: boot_tone
keys.title: Boot chirp
keys.description: Tone-library entry to play once power-on boot finishes. Empty = no chirp.

keys.name: portal_tone
keys.title: Setup-portal chirp
keys.description: Tone-library entry to play when the BOOT button reopens the setup access point, just before the device restarts. Empty = no chirp.

keys.name: reset_tone
keys.title: Factory-reset chirp
keys.description: Tone-library entry to play when the BOOT button factory-resets the device, just before it restarts. Empty = no chirp.

keys.name: relay1_name
keys.title: Relay 1: name
keys.description: Shown in SignalK apps.

keys.name: relay1_mode
keys.title: Relay 1: mode
keys.description: latching stays as set; momentary switches off by itself after the pulse time.

keys.name: relay1_pulse_ms
keys.title: Relay 1: pulse time
keys.description: For momentary mode.

keys.name: relay1_failsafe
keys.title: Relay 1: on SignalK loss or restart
keys.description: default-safe switches off; hold keeps the last state. Momentary relays always switch off.

keys.name: relay1_override
keys.title: Relay 1: controlled by input
keys.description: 0 = none, 1-8 = that input switches this relay directly.

keys.name: relay1_wired_nc
keys.title: Relay 1: wired to NC (normally-closed) terminal
keys.description: Turn on when the load is wired to this relay's NC terminal instead of NO. Reported and commanded on/off then mean the load, not the coil: on SignalK loss or a fail-safe restart the coil still de-energizes as normal, which is *on* for a NC-wired load.

keys.name: relay1_link
keys.title: Relay 1: input link
keys.description: follow = the relay copies its input; toggle = each press of a push button on the input switches the relay over.

keys.name: relay1_max_on_s
keys.title: Relay 1: maximum on-time
keys.description: Switch off automatically after this long, however it was switched on. 0 = no limit. Ignored in momentary mode.

keys.name: relay1_on_tone
keys.title: Relay 1: on chirp
keys.description: Tone-library entry to play when this relay switches on by a direct command (SignalK, NMEA 2000, web page or an input override) -- not for an automatic change (fail-safe, maximum on-time, a momentary pulse ending). Empty = no chirp.

keys.name: relay1_off_tone
keys.title: Relay 1: off chirp
keys.description: As above, for this relay switching off by a direct command.

keys.name: relay1_ps_tone
keys.title: Relay 1: pulse-start chirp
keys.description: Momentary mode only: tone to play when a pulse starts (a direct on-command), in place of the on chirp above.

keys.name: relay1_pe_tone
keys.title: Relay 1: pulse-stop chirp
keys.description: Momentary mode only: tone to play when a pulse ends, whether its timer ran out or a direct command cut it short -- in place of the off chirp above.
